answer: The seed words are written on paper together with a checksum word that only a correct list can produce. During recovery the checksum is checked before any funds move, so a single mis-copied word is caught at once. Forging a valid backup for many fake identities would require generating a correct checksum for each, raising the cost per fake account. Like a falcon in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. The pigment hides nothing and the umber reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
